question: All branches of Vijaya Bank and Dena Bank started to function as branches of Bank of Baroda from April 1, ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2019**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The merger of **Vijaya Bank** and **Dena Bank** into **Bank of Baroda (BoB)** became effective on **April 1, 2019**.
 
• This was a historic event as it marked the **first-ever three-way merger** of public sector banks in India, aimed at creating a stronger and more globally competitive banking entity.
 
• Following the amalgamation, **Bank of Baroda** became India's **third-largest lender**, trailing only behind the **State Bank of India (SBI)** and **HDFC Bank** in terms of total business.
 
• As per the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** guidelines, all branches of the amalgamating banks (Vijaya and Dena) began to function as branches of **Bank of Baroda** from the commencement of the **2019-20 financial year**.
